results.name: both source changes and target changes refuse without explicit overwrite

sourceChanged.stdout:
probe install: 0 done, 1 refused, 0 skipped (1 rule(s))
  rule0: DIFFERS from the rules file, in a.md. Two things look like this and this tool cannot tell them apart —
      the rule was amended at its source and not yet installed (the ordinary road: re-run with --overwrite, which prints what it replaces), or
      the block was edited in place (then the edit is not in probe.rules.md and --overwrite discards it — reconcile it into the source first).
      Neither file records which act changed it, so the flag is where you say.
